newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco says Israel policy can only bring violence.
newsitem.headline: Morocco says Israel policy can only bring violence.

text.p: Moroccan King Hassan has accused Israel of ignoring commitments and following a policy that could only bring "the return of a cycle of violence and instability to the (Middle East) region".
In a message late on Thursday to U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali after two days of violence in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, the king said:

"Israel has violated the terms of these agreements in undertaking measures aimed at isolating Jerusalem, in extending (Jewish) settlements, and restricting building activities in Arab quarters, without taking account of archaeological digs likely to undermine the foundations of the holy mosque of Al-Aqsa."

King Hassan, who heads the Jerusalem Committee, called on the international community to assume its responsibilities in imposing (international) law and opposing all measures likely to harm the legitimate rights of Arabs and Moslems.
Palestinians accused Israel of provoking the bloodshed by opening a tunnel beside the Dome of the Rock and al-Aqsa mosque complex in Jerusalem's walled Old City.
Israel blamed the Palestinian Authority for the two days of gun battles.

The Moroccan government on Thursday night also condemned the opening of the Jerusalem tunnel, which it said was a "flagrant violation of all U.N. resolutions on preserving the sites of the holy city, Jerusalem".
